data_savings_assessment.rule: A parent-saving target is supported only when a lower-budget JS measured mean reaches the larger-budget ERM mean and the paired 95% bootstrap interval for JS minus ERM is entirely above zero. No extrapolation or interpolated counts are used as evidence.

primary_metric: mean Macro-F1 across six simulated single-factor OOD profiles and three evaluation seeds

gpu.nvidia_smi: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, 16376 MiB, 591.86

historical_eight_hour_comparison.note: 8/24/40 are individual method-run counts; each paired cell runs ERM and JS together, so the estimate uses 4/12/20 paired cells and excludes one-time panel-cache construction and artifact transfer
historical_eight_hour_comparison.source: user recollection; not verified local wall-time provenance

provenance.output_root: CUIFA local ignored output directory (excluded from Git)

runtime_audit.gpu_scope_note: Sampled whole-device utilization; may include other processes and is not attributable solely to the experiment.

source_benchmark_comparison.caveat: The source benchmark used an RTX 4060 Laptop GPU and 8/8; CUIFA used an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER and 12/12. The observed ratio includes hardware and runtime differences and is not a software-only effect. The historical ~8-hour run is user recollection, not verified wall-time provenance.
